note: Present each case exactly as written and ask the prompts in order. Grading is done by an AI tutor or a mentor.

verdict_options.insufficient: Insufficient evidence, keep it open and get more data

prompts: What is your verdict: close, escalate, or insufficient evidence (keep it open)?
What evidence supports your verdict? If something is missing, name exactly what and where you would get it.
How would different findings change your decision?
What safe interim action would you take right now, and when will you review again?
Write a 3-line ticket note: what you know, what you don't know, and the next step.

cases.title: New-country sign-in for a senior account
cases.alert: Successful sign-in to the CFO's email account from a country the user has not signed in from before. Severity: Medium.
cases.context: Executive account; the mailbox holds finance data. It is 14:10 on a Tuesday.
evidence: Sign-in succeeded at 13:52 UTC from 203.0.113.77 (a hosting-provider address range)
Only this one sign-in event is visible. Sign-in logs older than 24 hours are not retained
The user's calendar shows no out-of-office entry
No endpoint (EDR) telemetry is available for the device used

cases.title: Office app launches encoded PowerShell
cases.alert: EDR: Word spawned PowerShell with an encoded command, followed by an outbound connection. Severity: High.
cases.context: Finance laptop. The user opened an emailed invoice attachment 3 minutes earlier.
evidence: Full process tree: WINWORD.EXE then powershell.exe -enc <long string> then rundll32.exe
The decoded command downloads a file from hxxp://invoice-update[.]example/a.bin
The domain is flagged malicious by three independent reputation sources and was registered 2 days ago
The attachment's hash appears in a published phishing-campaign report
EDR shows the connection succeeded and a new scheduled task was created

cases.title: Web attack signature, but no web logs
cases.alert: IDS: SQL injection pattern in an HTTP request to the customer portal. Severity: Medium.
cases.context: Internet-facing customer portal that holds customer personal data.
evidence: The IDS captured one request with a quote-and-UNION pattern in a URL parameter at 02:14 UTC from 198.51.100.23
The IDS cannot see the server's response (traffic is encrypted after the load balancer)
The web server access logs and database error logs for this host are not ingested into the SIEM
The web application firewall (WAF) log is not available for this period

cases.title: Port scan from the vulnerability scanner
cases.alert: IDS: one internal host probed about 1,000 ports on 40 servers. Severity: Medium.
evidence: 192.0.2.50 is listed in the asset inventory as the company's approved vulnerability scanner
A change ticket approves a scan of these servers from 02:00 to 04:00 today, approved by the infrastructure owner
The alert time is 02:12
The traffic matches the scanner's usual pattern and stops at 03:41
No other alerts involve this host or the targets

cases.title: Large upload from a server
cases.alert: Firewall: 8 GB sent from a database server to an external cloud-storage address at 02:30. Severity: Medium.
cases.context: The server hosts internal reporting data. Normal outbound traffic is under 100 MB per day.
evidence: Flow data shows the 8 GB upload over HTTPS to 198.51.100.200 (owned by a public cloud-storage provider)
No EDR agent is installed on this server
Proxy and DLP logs do not cover server traffic
The backup schedule and any approved data-transfer ticket are unknown

cases.title: Log cleared, new admin and a new service
cases.alert: Server: the security log was cleared, then a user was added to the local administrators group, then a new service was installed. Severity: High.
cases.context: Application server. All three events happened within 10 minutes at 03:05 UTC.
evidence: All three events came from the account svc-deploy-test using logon type 10 (Remote Desktop) from 203.0.113.99
The account's owner is on leave and says they have not logged in
No change ticket or maintenance window exists for tonight
EDR shows the new service launches an unsigned program from a temporary folder
The source address is not in any company range

cases.title: Regular connections to an unknown address
cases.alert: Network analytics: a laptop connects to the same external IP every 60 seconds. Severity: Low.
cases.context: A marketing laptop. The pattern has run for 3 days.
evidence: Flow data: small packets every 60 seconds to 198.51.100.77 on TCP 443
No DNS logs are available for this laptop
No endpoint telemetry: the laptop's agent last checked in 9 days ago
The IP has no reputation data, good or bad

cases.title: Reported phishing email with only a screenshot
cases.alert: A user reports a suspicious 'password expiry' email and sends a screenshot.
cases.context: HR department. The email gateway keeps messages for only 3 days, and the email arrived 5 days ago.
evidence: The screenshot shows the sender's display name but not the full address or headers
The link text reads 'Reset password' but the real URL is not visible
The user says they did not click anything but is not sure
The gateway no longer holds the original message
No other reports of the same email so far
